text: Your daily tea or coffee is not even our tradition. But it quietly takes twenty five rupees from you every day.
Tea became a mass Indian habit through British era tea board campaigns. In the nineteen thirties they handed out millions of free cups, with posters at railway stations.
And in Tamil Nadu, mornings began with neeraagaaram. Coffee only won people over in the early nineteen hundreds.
So here is a swap. Put that twenty five rupees into a daily SIP, only on working days.
That is one hundred and twenty five rupees a week, about five hundred and ten rupees a month, and around six thousand one hundred a year.
In twenty years, you would invest about one lakh twenty two thousand rupees.
If it grew the way the Nifty fifty did over the last twenty years, about twelve percent a year, it could be around four point nine lakh rupees.
But past returns are not a promise. Markets fall too, so this needs patience, not luck.
Would you swap one tea for this? Comment SIP, and save this.
